look_here_first: Look for a leafless flower stalk with a terminal umbel of funnel-shaped six-tepaled flowers. Look into the throat for the distinctive crown made by joined stamen filaments. Confirm basal linear leaves; do not use flower color alone.

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Small spring perennial from corm; glabrous leafless scape 10–20(–35) cm.

key_traits.label: Leaves
key_traits.text: Several narrow basal leaves 10–30(–35) cm long and 1.5–3 mm wide.

key_traits.label: Flower attachment
key_traits.text: Terminal umbel of 2–6(–9) stalked flowers, pedicels about 1–2(–2.5) cm.

key_traits.label: Flowers
key_traits.text: Six partly united tepals form a funnel; perianth 1.5–2.5(–3) cm. Six stamen filaments form an inner crown; anthers 2–4 mm.

key_traits.label: Fruit seed
key_traits.text: Three-angled capsules 1–1.5 cm; flat black seeds 7–9 mm.
